decision: Present-self versus present-friend trait-ascription wording uniquely maps to Study1 undergraduate comparison. Methods and Fig1caption assign friend conditions to undergraduates; staff sample has past/present self only. Direct copy F(1,61)=7.42/exact p.008; not the 4-condition omnibus, self-past contrast, Tukey followups or staff-sample self comparison. No default sample selection, df/N inference, correction of source recruitment inconsistencies or transfer of broad replication narrative.
